items.text: Pedro Antonio Casas is a forensic psychologist and retired U.S. Army colonel. He earned a Ph.D. in counseling psychology from UC Santa Barbara and spent more than 29 years in the military, commanding units in Germany.

sentences.text: Pedro Antonio Casas is a forensic psychologist and retired U.S. Army colonel.
He earned a Ph.D. in counseling psychology from UC Santa Barbara and spent more than 29 years in the military, commanding units in Germany.

items.text: Casas identifies the high cost of living as the district’s major issue and says California Democrats are responsible for it. He pledges to audit all government spending, find fraud, and lower taxes at all levels. He also says he would investigate and work to lower housing costs. He does not support expanding Medicare and wants to audit healthcare services. His campaign proposes tax cuts, reducing bureaucratic red tape and regulations on small businesses, and allowing the free market to recalibrate itself.

items.text: He has proposed a “Dr. Casas Immigration Bill” and argues that sanctuary policies protect criminals. He opposes taxpayer funding for abortion providers, stating that life begins at conception. He advocates for requiring biological males to compete only against other biological males in sports. His campaign also supports expanding behavioral health support for veterans and developing mental health and substance abuse treatment facilities for homeless individuals.
